article_basis: Article 36 of Regulation (EU) 2023/1114 (Requirement to have a reserve of assets for Asset-Referenced Tokens)
tail_convention: Coverage is a higher-is-better metric. The LOW tail (values approaching or falling below 100%) is adverse. This test examines the point estimate, which serves as the baseline before examining the adverse LOW tail in stress scenarios.
weakest_point: Point-in-time valuation of reserve assets can fluctuate intraday, meaning a passing point estimate might mask intraday shortfalls if bond prices drop momentarily.

result.verdict: Cannot be definitively evaluated without the UNKNOWN_CURRENT_VALUE parameters, but mechanically structured to test against the greater of the percentage or fixed minimum.

article_basis: Article 35 of Regulation (EU) 2023/1114 (Own funds requirement for Asset-Referenced Tokens)
tail_convention: Own funds capital adequacy is a higher-is-better metric. The LOW tail (capital depletion falling below the threshold) is adverse. The test examines whether the actual capital falls into the adverse LOW tail below the regulatory requirement.
weakest_point: Using UNKNOWN_CURRENT_VALUE parameters prevents a definitive pass/fail verdict, highlighting that regulatory thresholds subject to change or specific EBA RTS must be hardcoded dynamically rather than guessed.

article_basis: Article 36 of Regulation (EU) 2023/1114 (Reserve of assets composition and stress testing requirements)
tail_convention: Coverage is a higher-is-better metric. The LOW tail (asset value decline) is adverse. This stress test explicitly examines the adverse LOW tail of the reserve asset distribution by applying negative haircuts to simulate a market downturn.
weakest_point: Assumes static liabilities (token supply remains exactly 1,000,000 EUR) during the stress event, ignoring potential simultaneous redemption runs that would exacerbate the shortfall.

result.test_against: Redemption at par obligation and post-redemption full-backing

article_basis: Article 39 of Regulation (EU) 2023/1114 (Rights of holders of asset-referenced tokens to redeem at par)
tail_convention: Liquidity and coverage are higher-is-better metrics. The LOW tail (cash depletion exceeding liquid reserves) is adverse. This test examines whether the cash outflow pushes the reserve into the adverse LOW tail below 100% coverage.
weakest_point: Assumes the 100,000 EUR payout is sourced entirely from cash equivalents without forcing the sale of illiquid bonds at a loss, which would occur in a real liquidity stress scenario.
